_note: Dev items whose text appears verbatim in data/grammar/. Retrieval finds these by string overlap, so they are excluded from the retrieval_hit_rate sample and are listed by id rather than counted: a count lets a new collision through by editing one digit, and an id has to be added on a line where a reason can be written. Held-out items may never appear here — tests/test_grammar_reference.py fails on any overlap with the test split, and on any test id present in this file.
